labels.must_not_cite: No document supports the claim. Any citation is wrong.

documents.retention:
Customer Data Retention Policy (version 3)

Scope: this policy applies to customer account records held by the operations team.

Customer records are retained for a minimum of 30 days after account closure.
After the retention period, records are deleted within a further 60 days unless a legal hold applies.
Backups containing customer records are rotated every 90 days.
Requests for early deletion are handled by the privacy office.

Employee Travel Policy

Flights: employees must book economy class for flights shorter than six hours.
Premium economy may be booked for flights of six hours or longer with manager approval.
Hotels: the nightly hotel cap in Lisbon is 160 EUR.
Meals: receipts are required for every meal expense above 25 EUR.
Travel must be booked through the company travel portal at least 14 days in advance.

documents.expense:
Employee Expense Policy (version 2)

1. Scope
This policy covers business expenses that employees pay personally and claim back through the expense system.

2. Meals
Meal expenses are reimbursed up to 45 EUR per day when travelling.
A receipt is required for every meal expense above 25 EUR.
Alcohol is not reimbursed.

3. Local transport
Taxis are reimbursed when public transport is not available or the trip starts before 6:00.
Ride-sharing is treated as a taxi.

4. Submission
Expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense date.
Claims older than 60 days are rejected unless a manager approves an exception.

5. Approval
Claims up to 500 EUR are approved by the line manager.
Claims above 500 EUR also require finance approval.
documents.security:
Information Security Policy (version 5)

1. Purpose
This policy sets the minimum security controls for company systems, accounts, and data. It applies to all employees, contractors, and temporary staff who use company equipment or access company services. Line managers are responsible for making sure their teams have read it.

2. Accounts and passwords
Every person receives a personal account. Shared accounts are not permitted except for documented service accounts owned by the IT team.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.
Passwords for standard accounts must be changed every 90 days.
Passwords for administrator accounts must be changed every 30 days.
A password may not be reused within the last 12 changes.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, the VPN, and every administrator account.

3. Devices
Company laptops must use full-disk encryption.
Screens must lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.
Personal devices may access email only through the approved mobile management app.
Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the service desk within 24 hours.

4. Data classification
Data is classified as public, internal, confidential, or restricted.
Confidential data may be shared outside the company only with a signed non-disclosure agreement.
Restricted data, including payment card data, may never be stored on laptops or in email.

5. Access reviews
Managers review the access rights of their team every quarter.
Access for leavers is removed on their last working day.
Administrator access is reviewed every month by the IT security team.

6. Backups and recovery
Production databases are backed up every night.
Backups are kept for 35 days and tested by a restore exercise twice a year.
The recovery time objective for customer-facing systems is 8 hours.

7. Incidents
Suspected security incidents must be reported to the security team immediately and no later than 1 hour after discovery.
The security team notifies the data protection officer within 24 hours when personal data may be affected.

8. Software
Only software from the approved catalogue may be installed on company devices.
Security patches rated critical are installed within 7 days of release.
Browser extensions require approval from the IT team.

9. Exceptions
Exceptions to this policy must be approved in writing by the head of IT security and are valid for at most 6 months.
